name: Gluetun Gateway
description: Gluetun configured as a VPN gateway/router for other LXCs on a shared VXLAN. Routes all client internet traffic through the WireGuard or OpenVPN tunnel of any Gluetun-supported provider, with a kill switch, tunneled DNS, and NAT-PMP port forwarding.

notes.text: The builder only creates net0 (WAN/uplink). Add the VXLAN NIC on the host with NO IP: pct set <ctid> -net1 name=eth1,bridge=<vxlan-vnet>. The script prompts for the subnet/gateway IP and assigns eth1 itself (works even before the VXLAN is wired).

Edit /etc/gluetun/gluetun.env: set VPN_SERVICE_PROVIDER, VPN_TYPE and the matching credentials (e.g. WIREGUARD_PRIVATE_KEY); adjust CLIENT_SUBNET/GATEWAY_IP if needed, then run: systemctl restart gluetun-gateway-net && systemctl restart gluetun.
Client LXCs need a VXLAN NIC (default gateway = this LXC), a LAN NIC with no default gateway, DNS pointed here, and the RA/DHCP default-gateway suppressed on the LAN interface.
Forwarded port: file /gluetun/forwarded_port, or GET http://<ip>:8000/v1/portforward.
